sloka: यदाज्ञप्तं महाराज सर्वं तत्कृतवानहम् ।हतः स लवणः पापः पुरी चास्य निवेशिता ।। ७.७२.१० ॥
transliteration: yadājñaptaṁ mahārāja sarvaṁ tatkṛtavānaham ।hataḥ sa lavaṇaḥ pāpaḥ purī cāsya niveśitā ।। 7.72.10 ॥

translations.english: O great king, I have accomplished all that you commanded: the wicked Lavana has been slain, and his city has been established.
